algorithm_long: Supervised gradient fine-tuning of the public TabPFN-v2 regression foundation model for crystal-structure exfoliation energy. Analytic composition and periodic geometry yield 370 features. For each official outer TRAIN fold independently, composition-group three-fold CV selects one of four fixed fine-tuning configurations, followed by actual gradient refitting on the entire outer TRAIN. Four final folds update the full network and one updates only its readout. All five final models are frozen before separate-process witness replay and any held-out prediction or native scoring. Built with PriorLabs-TabPFN. REVIEW CORRECTION IN PROGRESS: the original four-configuration search was narrowed using fold0 development, whose labels overlap other official test folds. The original result therefore has design-selection bias risk. A frozen retrospective correction reselects all historical feature, schedule, inference and positive blend alternatives independently within each own TRAIN. Historical exposure is disclosed and cannot be erased by rerunning.
notes: DRAFT / NOT READY FOR ACCEPTANCE: results.json.gz still preserves the original 28.733328891325755 meV/atom result, SHA256 19f4d666716d4244f69e5dcbe037d42ac3bfdd4f4ae8d8ecd02b150e589d3a26. This is not asserted to be design-unbiased. Original fold0 development includes 127 test rows from each other outer fold; v3 narrowed the schedule after v2 development worsened. See REVIEW_RESPONSE.md and development-history.json. A reviewer-requested correction is running from the pre-execution corrected-protocol-freeze.json: 1206 genuinely trained/positive-trained-contribution alternatives selected only inside each own TRAIN, all five final fits frozen before fresh-process inference/native scoring. The corrected result will replace the original regardless of score direction. No completed corrected result or full public rerun is claimed yet. Built with PriorLabs-TabPFN. Only matbench_jdft2d is submitted.
